metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have the most amount of active fire detections in 2016 compared to all other years from 2012 to 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collections: MODIS 8-day Thermal Anomalies (Terra: MODIS/006/MOD14A1, Aqua: MODIS/006/MYD14A1).
- Date: 2012-01-01 to 2024-12-31.
- Location: Union of Indian states Punjab and Haryana from FAO/GAUL/2015 level1.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not a cloud question. Use FireMask >= 7 (low/nominal/high confidence) as "active fire". No cloud masking needed beyond product mask.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes. If all years have zero images across both sensors => C1.
- Compute yearly fire pixel detections by summing binary fire masks over the year and reducing over geometry. Handle empty collections per-year safely.
- If any calculation returns null/NaN => C3.
- Otherwise, compare 2016 versus max of all years. If unique max => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const startYear = 2012;
    const endYear = 2024;
    const years = ee.List.sequence(startYear, endYear);
    const states = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'India'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.inList('ADM1_NAME', ['Punjab', 'Haryana']));
    const geom = states.geometry();

    // 2. Collections (MODIS Terra/Aqua 8-day Fire)
    const terraColAll = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1');
    const aquaColAll = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1');

    // Helper: compute yearly fire-pixel detections and image counts for a collection
    function yearlyStatsForCollection(col, y) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 1, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'year');
      const ic = col.filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom);
      const imgCount = ic.size();
      // Sum of binary fire masks (FireMask >= 7) over the year -> total fire-pixel detections
      const fireSum = ee.Algorithms.If(
        imgCount.gt(0),
        ic.map(function (img) {
          return img.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('F');
        })
          .sum()
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: geom,
            scale: 1000,
            maxPixels: 1e9
          })
          .get('F'),
        0
      );
      return ee.Dictionary({ imgs: imgCount, fire: ee.Number(fireSum) });
    }

    // 3. Build server-side results for all years
    const resultsFC = ee.FeatureCollection(
      years.map(function (y) {
        y = ee.Number(y);
        const t = yearlyStatsForCollection(terraColAll, y);
        const a = yearlyStatsForCollection(aquaColAll, y);
        const totalFire = ee.Number(t.get('fire')).add(ee.Number(a.get('fire')));
        const tImgs = ee.Number(t.get('imgs'));
        const aImgs = ee.Number(a.get('imgs'));
        return ee.Feature(null, {
          year: y,
          fire: totalFire,
          tImgs: tImgs,
          aImgs: aImgs
        });
      })
    );

    // 4. Pull results client-side
    const results = await resultsFC.getInfo();
    if (!results || !results.features) {
      console.log('Error: No results retrieved.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // Parse and validate
    const parsed = results.features
      .map(f => {
        const p = f.properties || {};
        return {
          year: p.year,
          fire: p.fire,
          tImgs: p.tImgs,
          aImgs: p.aImgs
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);

    // Check for empty collections across entire period
    const totalImgs = parsed.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.tImgs || 0) + (r.aImgs || 0), 0);
    if (totalImgs === 0) {
      console.log(`All years images: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Check for invalid numbers
    const anyInvalid = parsed.some(
      r =>
        r.fire === null ||
        r.fire === undefined ||
        Number.isNaN(r.fire) ||
        r.year === null ||
        r.year === undefined
    );
    if (anyInvalid) {
      console.log('Invalid numeric result encountered.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Evidence printout (<=20 lines)
    console.log('Region: Punjab+Haryana, Dataset: MODIS MOD14A1/MYD14A1, FireMask>=7');
    parsed.forEach(r => {
      const f = Math.round(r.fire || 0);
      const ti = r.tImgs || 0;
      const ai = r.aImgs || 0;
      console.log(`${r.year}: imgs T/A=${ti}/${ai}, FirePix=${f}`);
    });

    // Determine if 2016 is the unique maximum
    const maxFire = parsed.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.fire || 0), 0);
    const maxYears = parsed.filter(r => Math.round(r.fire || 0) === Math.round(maxFire)).map(r => r.year);
    const fire2016 = parsed.find(r => r.year === 2016)?.fire || 0;
    console.log(`Max Year(s): ${maxYears.join(', ')}, 2016 FirePix=${Math.round(fire2016)}`);

    const is2016UniqueMax =
      Math.round(fire2016) === Math.round(maxFire) && maxYears.length === 1;

    // 6. Final Answer
    console.log(is2016UniqueMax ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
